# An ARM path API version uses the client-level override

## TypeSpec

```tsp
@armProviderNamespace
@versioned(Versions)
namespace Microsoft.Test;

enum Versions {
  v2022_01_01: "2022-01-01",
}

@get
@route("/api-version/{apiVersion}")
op get(@path apiVersion: string): void;
```
